summary.text: Courtenay Sprunger is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 7 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She founded and led a public involvement firm in Kalispell.

paragraphs.text: Sprunger was born in and lives in Kalispell, Montana.
Her career experience includes founding and working as CEO of her own public involvement firm.

She served on the boards of the Kalispell Chamber of Commerce, the Conrad Mansion and Flathead Area Young Professionals, chaired the Montana chapter of the Public Relations Society of America, and joined the Kalispell Daybreak Rotary.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Local Government Committee, where she is vice chair, and to the Rules, Transportation, and Business and Labor committees.
